-- Prueft die Bruecke Rechnung zu Buchung ueber invoice_item.transaction_id.
-- Nur lesend. Ausgabe als Kennzahlenliste.
WITH bruecke AS (
    SELECT
        i.item_key,
        i.invoice_id,
        i.item_type,
        i.vat_percent,
        i.amount,
        t.transaction_id,
        t.booking_id
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
           ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
),
je_rechnung AS (
    SELECT invoice_id, count(DISTINCT booking_id) AS buchungen
    FROM bruecke
    WHERE booking_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY invoice_id
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT booking_id, count(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS rechnungen
    FROM bruecke
    WHERE booking_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY booking_id
),
abdeckung AS (
    SELECT
        extract(year FROM r.date_create)::int AS jahr,
        count(*)                                                        AS rechnungen,
        count(r.tax_total)                                              AS mit_counts,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.anzahl > 0)                            AS mit_zeilen,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.anzahl > 0)                            AS mit_zahlung
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice r
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) AS anzahl FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line    GROUP BY 1) l ON l.invoice_id = r.invoice_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) AS anzahl FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_payment GROUP BY 1) p ON p.invoice_id = r.invoice_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM (
    -- A. Grundzahlen der Brücke
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Bruecke' AS bereich, 'posten gesamt' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, NULL::text AS hinweis FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'A Bruecke', 'posten mit vorgangskennung',
           count(transaction_id)::numeric, NULL FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'A Bruecke', 'posten mit treffer in booking_transaction',
           count(booking_id)::numeric, NULL FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 13, 'A Bruecke', 'posten mit kennung aber ohne treffer',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND booking_id IS NULL)::numeric,
           'verweist auf gelöschte oder fremde Buchung' FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 14, 'A Bruecke', 'posten ganz ohne kennung',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::numeric,
           (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT item_type, ', ') FROM bruecke WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)
           FROM bruecke

    -- B. Reichweite
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Reichweite', 'rechnungen gesamt',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM edoobox_raw.invoice
    UNION ALL SELECT 21, 'B Reichweite', 'rechnungen mit mindestens einer buchung',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 22, 'B Reichweite', 'rechnungen ohne jede buchung',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice r
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM je_rechnung j WHERE j.invoice_id = r.invoice_id))::numeric,
           NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 23, 'B Reichweite', 'buchungen erreicht',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM je_buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 24, 'B Reichweite', 'buchungen gesamt',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM edoobox_raw.booking
    UNION ALL SELECT 25, 'B Reichweite', 'buchungen ohne rechnung',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM je_buchung j WHERE j.booking_id = b.booking_id))::numeric,
           NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 26, 'B Reichweite', 'davon storniert oder warteliste',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM je_buchung j WHERE j.booking_id = b.booking_id)
               AND b.status <> 'gebucht')::numeric,
           NULL

    -- C. Buchungen je Rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'genau eine',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen = 1)::numeric, 'eindeutig' FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 31, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'zwei bis fuenf',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen BETWEEN 2 AND 5)::numeric, 'geschlossener Kurs' FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 32, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'sechs und mehr',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen >= 6)::numeric, 'Sammelrechnung' FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 33, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'hoechstwert',
           max(buchungen)::numeric, NULL FROM je_rechnung

    -- D. Rechnungen je Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Rechnungen je Buchung', 'genau eine',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE rechnungen = 1)::numeric, NULL FROM je_buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 41, 'D Rechnungen je Buchung', 'zwei und mehr',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE rechnungen >= 2)::numeric,
           'Teilzahlung, Storno mit Neuausstellung' FROM je_buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 42, 'D Rechnungen je Buchung', 'hoechstwert',
           max(rechnungen)::numeric, NULL FROM je_buchung

    -- E. Postenart
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Postenart', coalesce(item_type, 'ohne angabe'),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM bruecke GROUP BY item_type

    -- F. Steuersatz aus der Rechnung gegen B2B-Kennzeichen der Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Steuersatz', concat(coalesce(b.vat_percent::text, 'ohne'), ' Prozent'),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.is_b2b), ' / nicht b2b ',
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.is_b2b IS NOT TRUE))
           FROM bruecke b
           LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking k ON k.booking_id = b.booking_id
           GROUP BY b.vat_percent

    -- G. Betragsabgleich
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, 'G Betraege', 'summe posten brutto',
           round(sum(amount), 2), NULL FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 71, 'G Betraege', 'summe rechnungsbetrag',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice)::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 72, 'G Betraege', 'summe steuer aus counts',
           (SELECT round(sum(tax_total), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice)::numeric,
           'nur neuere Rechnungen'
    UNION ALL SELECT 73, 'G Betraege', 'summe belege',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_receipt)::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 74, 'G Betraege', 'summe zahlungen',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_payment)::numeric, NULL

    -- H. Abdeckung der Detailstruktur je Jahr
    UNION ALL SELECT 80, 'H Abdeckung je Jahr', coalesce(jahr::text, 'ohne datum'),
           rechnungen::numeric,
           concat('counts ', mit_counts, ' / zeilen ', mit_zeilen, ' / zahlung ', mit_zahlung)
           FROM abdeckung
) x
ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl;
